title: Aeriform
summary: A'ERIFORM, adjective [Latin aer, air, and forma, form.] Having the form or nature of air, or of an elastic, invisible fluid. The gases are aeriform fluids.

inlines.v: A'ERIFORM, adjective [Latin aer, air, and forma, form.] Having the form or nature of air, or of an elastic, invisible fluid. The gases are aeriform fluids.
